<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-04-1703-49-32" status="unreviewed">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsa ba</rs> na re bsgrub bya la rnam pa gnyis te yongs gcod rlom yul gyi bsgrub bya dang | mi bslu ba'i yul can gyi bsgrub bya'o ||
         dang po ni brda'i rgyu mtshan gyi chos kyi 'dra ba ba lang gi sgras brjod rung tsam po'o ||
         de gnyis la khyad par ci yod ce na|
         dngos po gcig kyang nges pa'i yul du gyur pa'i chos tha dad de brda'i rgyu mtshan gyi chos kyis 'dra ba zhes bya ba ni don chos yin la ba lang gi sgras brjod rung zhes bya ba'i tha snyad yin pas so || dper na byas pa dang <foreign xml:lang="sa-Latn-x-wylie">he du</foreign> bzhin no ||
         gnyis pa ni brda'i rgyu mtshan gyi chos kyis mi 'dra ba bkag tsam gyi med dgag ste |de'ang rtsod gzhi dang dpe gnyis ka brda'i rgyu mtshan gyi chos kyis 'dra ba dang |gnyis ka mi 'dra ba dang | rtsod gzhi 'dra la dpe mi 'dra ba dang | rtsod gzhi mi 'dra la dpe 'dra ba ste mu bzhi las 
         brda'i rgyu mtshan gyis chos kyis mi 'dra ba bkag tsam gyi med dgag gzhal ba ste dngos po la sgra dang don la 'brel ba med kyang blos yod par bzung bas don des kyang mi go bar nges la mi nges kyang don go bar byed pas so zhes zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
